events.message: Target E-commerce shop (16 services) at http://127.0.0.1 (namespace flexascale-apps)
Application data reset (2 configured steps)

Resetting replicas to minimum (HPAs held at their minimum during the reset)
Holding HPAs at their minimum for 287 s more: the HPA downscale window since the previous load must expire for a comparable start

FlexaScale operator holds the controller lease; HPAs are frozen per service before any scale
Auto mode: each service is assigned to FlexaScale or native HPA by the rules health -> confidence -> SLA risk -> efficiency, one owner at a time
